approval_required_for: Conditional bounded approval only if refreshed exact sample-project and Vivado-export evidence cannot uniquely authorize the VCS compile plan: approval must identify one cited wrapper/source hash, export context, and tool-profile-authorized executable. No approval is requested for the bounded harness and instrumentation repair itself.

consumes: current exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation-source hashes
current board-interface discovery identity and cited Vivado export facts
immutable target checkpoint and complete Transformer-block target-layer selection
prior r6 probe proposal as planning-only evidence
executable_actions.on_failure: Fail closed and retain all active SACG barriers and retries. Do not run VCS, synthesize, alter RTL, alter tolerance, substitute a wrapper, or reopen lower layers. If the immutable Stage6 contract lacks a required catalog/binding field, record a Stage6 verification-contract backtrack identifying that exact missing field. If current project evidence yields multiple plausible VCS compile authorities, stop and request the bounded approval listed below rather than guessing an executable or target.
produces: fresh hashes for all generated harness, loader-binding, reference, and testbench artifacts
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the earliest violated verification-semantic capability without changing accelerator architecture, numeric policy, checkpoint, stimulus, lower-layer RTL, or the user-supplied board wrapper. Materialize the missing board_tb.sv and multilayer harness using the exact wrapper/source hashes; catalog every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer; prove loader-to-DUT consumption; and generate expected outputs through real target-model inference. Incorporate the r6 probe only as bounded instrumentation with a new source hash and no semantic-contract change.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the candidate at board verification capability repair and use the fresh checker diff to repair only the catalog, loader binding, generated harness, source identity, or compile-plan authority that failed. Do not treat skipped VCS/AXI diagnostics as hardware evidence, do not modify lower-layer RTL, and do not promote.
executable_actions.rationale: Confirm that the repaired candidate actually satisfies the two prerequisite board gates with fresh hashes before requesting hardware trace evidence. This rerun distinguishes a repaired capability from unexecuted or stale reports and validates the exact board-source and Vivado-authority bindings needed by VCS.

consumes: verification/board_simulation/board_tb.sv and its fresh source hash
frozen numeric comparison policy and immutable input stimulus
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not patch a presumed output, AXI, or kernel root cause. Invoke the next causal-localization action on this newly hash-bound trace, preserve checkpoint/stimulus/reference/tolerance/wrapper hashes, and keep lower certificates closed unless the trace meets the explicit contradiction condition.
executable_actions.rationale: Once static prerequisites pass, execute the required current-layer boundary replay using the exact board wrapper and the r6 observation window. The replay must bind core start, accepted ingress, kernel/board egress, lifecycle frontier, data order, transfer count, and numeric comparison to the new harness hashes. It is the first permissible hardware-localization step because the prior replay was blocked by missing verification capability.

consumes: fresh board source-identity and harness hashes
current SACG active barriers and retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Block code repair and promotion if the trace lacks direct causal-boundary localization. Do not create a lower-layer backtrack unless the current trace, including direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal boundary, and current certificate evidence, explicitly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant. Otherwise return only a bounded board-scope repair task.
produces: SACG update recording either a board-only repair target or a specifically evidenced lower-layer backtrack request
executable_actions.rationale: Execute only when the fresh board replay fails. Localize the earliest causal boundary from real tool evidence before proposing a bounded loader, harness, wrapper, runtime, or RTL repair. A board frontier stall alone is insufficient to reopen the connected kernel.

consumes: passing fresh VCS replay, boundary trace, data-order, transfer-count, and numeric results
immutable target reference, numeric policy, stimulus, checkpoint, and DUT weight-binding manifest
exact wrapper/source-identity and Vivado compile-authority artifacts
current SACG barriers and open retry-request records
executable_actions.on_failure: Leave all old and new failing artifacts behind trust barriers, retain the Stage7 retry, and return to the current board causal-localization action with fresh failing evidence. Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime.
produces: fresh SACG retry/barrier reconciliation record bound to current candidate hashes
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the fresh VCS replay passes, execute the remaining board gates in dependency order and build board semantic evidence from the exact current candidate. Reconcile the ten active barriers and retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, and retry_request.0142 only if newly hashed evidence passes every required board gate; this action does not authorize backend or board-runtime promotion.

observations: real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline executed and failed with missing multilayer_real_weight_binding and multilayer_harness_sources. This is a verification-capability/harness failure, not RTL value, AXI, DDR, ordering, liveness, or numeric failure evidence.

functional_sim is a dependency-unsatisfied aggregate failure. VCS, the VCS analyzer, AXI/deadlock diagnostics, and board semantic evidence are not_run, so the historical output-frontier report cannot be used as current RTL root-cause evidence.

The pending axi_ddr_interface report identifies required readiness work: a ready simulation artifact, source identity matching the current identity document, and VCS compile-plan authority bound to exact Vivado export facts. It is dependency-skipped and must be rerun after multilayer-pipeline repair rather than treated as an independently executed failure.

Operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer certificates are live and hash-bound. The connected kernel remains an elastic variable-latency pipeline with preserved boundary order and required cross-token overlap; no current direct core-start, ingress, egress, named-boundary, and certificate contradiction exists. Lower layers remain closed.

The ready-to-apply r6 probe is planning/debug evidence only. It may correct the testbench observation trigger after the required harness is materialized, but it neither proves weight consumption nor supplies functional pass evidence.

The authoritative SACG truth has 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and four open same-scope retry requests. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts may guide repair only; they cannot be consumed as validated candidate evidence or cleared without fresh current-candidate checks.
The conditional design-team router selected no specialist split. Its classification supports, but does not replace, the executed checker evidence.
proposed_actions: Materialize a new hash-bound board semantic harness using only the exact user sample-project wrapper and current discovery/Vivado-export evidence. Bind the complete Transformer-block-only tensor catalog through the loader to the DUT and produce expected values by target-model inference on the immutable stimulus/checkpoint.

Rerun the two current static readiness gates, case_multilayer_pipeline followed by case_axi_ddr_interface. Do not start VCS until both pass with fresh artifact hashes and authorized compile-plan evidence.

After static readiness passes, run the r6-instrumented current-board VCS targeted replay and localize only from its fresh boundary trace. Preserve the certified lower-layer closure unless that trace directly contradicts a named certificate invariant.

If the replay fails, create a current CCTG causal repair context before any wrapper, runtime, loader, or RTL patch. A lower-layer backtrack is conditional on an explicit current contradiction and must be recorded separately.

If replay passes, run the remaining required board gates in dependency order and reconcile the active SACG retry/barrier records only against newly generated passing artifacts; backend, implementation, bitstream, and runtime remain blocked until then.
risks: Model and weight risk: a partial, sampled, or disk-only weight manifest could appear valid while the DUT never consumes every required Transformer-block tensor in every target layer.

Numeric and data-provenance risk: expected outputs must come from a real target-model run on the same immutable checkpoint and stimulus; neither random expected data nor RTL-derived expected data is permissible, and tolerance values must remain fixed.
Integration risk: generating board_tb.sv against a simplified wrapper, stale source hash, guessed executable, or unbound Vivado export would invalidate AXI/DDR conclusions.

Memory/runtime and data-order risk: loader addresses, transfer counts, tensor ordering, and DDR images must be checked using the exact materialized runtime stream and board wrapper, not inferred from a manifest.

Trace risk: an output-frontier stall is only a localization symptom. It cannot prove a kernel defect or justify reopening the certified connected kernel without the required current contradiction evidence.

SACG trust risk: historical failed discovery and repair lineages remain downstream-consumption blockers; a new repair candidate needs distinct content hashes and full Stage7 validation before retry reconciliation or promotion.

constraints: exact board wrapper and source-hash identity
no lower-layer reopen without a current hash-bound contradiction
elastic variable-latency connected-kernel ordering and cross-token-overlap invariant
SACG rejected-artifact trust barriers and open Stage7 retry requests
edges: complete Transformer-block tensor catalog -> bound loader -> DUT consumption evidence -> hash-verified multilayer harness -> case_multilayer_pipeline
exact user sample-project wrapper and Vivado export facts -> source-identity-bound simulation compile plan -> case_axi_ddr_interface -> VCS boundary replay
immutable checkpoint and stimulus -> real target-model Transformer-block reference -> fixed numeric comparison -> board semantic evidence
certified connected kernel -> reusable lower-layer invariant for board integration; reopening requires a current direct contradiction trace

Repair this verification capability first, then run a fresh current-board boundary replay; do not modify or reopen certified leaf or connected-kernel RTL without a new hash-bound trace that directly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.
